That changes with USVC: a new SEC-registered fund by AngelList Asset Management that broadens access to venture capital, allowing retail investors to gain exposure to promising companies before they become well-known. USVC leverages AngelList’s network of 4,500+ active managers running 25,000+ funds and backing 13,000+ active startups to access exposure to tomorrow’s defining companies About the Role: This is a rare opportunity to reshape how the public invests in innovation. You'll come in at the ground level to help build a world-class operations function at the forefront of venture and fintech, backed by AngelList's platform and reputation. You will own transforming investment decisions into closed positions. You will support USVC and a growing range of co-invest vehicles, accounts, and funds as our asset management business scales. This role owns the process that scales expanding private market access.

Our clients include Hyundai, Kia, Genesis, MGM, Zillow and McDonald’s (to name a few…). Our agency cultivates an environment where all are welcome to push outside their comfort zones to solve problems in new ways. We encourage the team to be its best by creating the most positive workplace experience for all. For instance, we outpace the industry on diversity and inclusion AND offer continuous training and workshops for career development. So, if you dare to challenge the comfortable… then keep reading. The Role The Analyst Social Media position is entry-level. In this position, you will learn about account and media responsibilities. This team member will also learn media concepts and develop best practices for campaign set-up, management, and reporting. The ability to work as part of a team is crucial, as is a sense of innate curiosity, attention to detail and a self-motivated work ethic.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:0fab1121-9eb2-.title: Director of Marketing
jobgether-jobgether:lever:0fab1121-9eb2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Marketing based in Belgium. This is a senior, commercially minded marketing leadership role focused on turning brand awareness into measurable revenue and scalable growth. You will own the full marketing strategy across acquisition, conversion, retention, lifecycle, brand, content, and community. As a player-coach, you will lead the Marketing team while staying close to performance data, creative execution, and optimization. You will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to support growth and expansion into new markets. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution in a fast-moving, high-growth environment. You will also build the systems, playbooks, and processes needed to scale marketing efficiently across multiple locations. This is an opportunity for a bold, data-driven leader who knows how to build a memorable brand while delivering strong commercial results. Own and evolve the overall marketing strategy across growth, lifecycle, brand, content, and community, translating company growth and revenue objectives into clear priorities, budgets, KPIs, and measurable outcomes. Lead marketing analytics and reporting, maintaining clear visibility into channel performance, customer behavior, acquisition, conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Develop a deep understanding of target customers and use behavioral insights to improve the full customer journey from discovery through purchase, repeat visits, and advocacy. Own profitable customer acquisition and ticket sales across markets, overseeing paid media, SEO, and other growth channels while driving continuous testing and optimization of CAC, ROAS, conversion, and LTV. Oversee e-commerce and digital conversion performance, including landing pages, offers, booking journeys, mobile experiences, and checkout. Build repeatable marketing playbooks for launching and scaling new locations, working closely with Operations to align marketing investment with ticket inventory, seasonality, and market performance. Identify and test new channels, audiences, offers, partnerships, and creative concepts to unlock additional growth opportunities. Own retention and loyalty initiatives across email, SMS, memberships, referrals, reactivation, and other lifecycle programs designed to increase repeat visits, frequency, and customer lifetime value. Use segmentation and customer insights to create relevant, personalized communications and partner with Customer Experience to translate feedback into improvements. Protect and evolve the brand as the business expands, leading content, social, creator, influencer, PR, community, and local activation strategies. Develop campaigns and experiences that generate genuine participation, conversation, sharing, and advocacy across markets. Lead, coach, and develop the Marketing team while maintaining hands-on involvement in execution and performance optimization. Manage agencies, freelancers, and external partners, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable for measurable results. Establish the right balance of internal and external capabilities as the marketing function scales. Build efficient systems, reporting structures, processes, and playbooks that allow Marketing to support significantly more locations without proportional headcount growth. Recruit and develop high-performing marketing talent and establish strong collaboration across Marketing, Operations, Sales, Customer Experience, Technology, and Expansion. Balance long-term brand building with the immediate commercial priorities of a rapidly growing business. Requirements 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, including experience leading, coaching, and developing a marketing team. Proven experience in a consumer-facing, multi-location, DTC, e-commerce, wellness, hospitality, or experience-led business.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:dd32b9f3-b79b-.title: Vendor Security & Standards Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:dd32b9f3-b79b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Vendor Security & Standards Manager based in Ireland. This is a senior global security role focused on ensuring external supply chain partners consistently meet rigorous security standards. You will own vendor security requirements across carriers, 3PLs, freight forwarders, guarding companies, and last-mile providers. The role combines standards ownership, physical compliance inspections, corrective action management, and vendor performance oversight. You will operate across multiple international regions, identifying security gaps and driving measurable improvements across a complex vendor network. Success requires a firm, independent approach and the ability to hold vendors accountable while building effective working relationships. The position offers significant exposure to global supply chain security, critical infrastructure, and rapidly evolving technology environments. Extensive international travel will be an important part of the role, with occasional availability required for urgent compliance matters. Own and continuously improve the global vendor security standards framework, ensuring requirements remain comprehensive, current, enforceable, and aligned with relevant policies and industry best practices. Establish and enforce clear security compliance expectations for carriers, 3PLs, freight forwarders, guarding companies, last-mile providers, and other external supply chain partners. Ensure vendors formally accept applicable security requirements before beginning operational activities and work with legal and procurement teams to embed these obligations into contracts and service agreements. Conduct scheduled and unannounced physical inspections at vendor facilities, transit locations, and operational sites across international regions. Verify controls such as access management, personnel screening, CCTV, handling procedures, tamper-evident measures, and chain-of-custody processes against established standards, including TAPA FSR and TAPA TSR where applicable. Produce detailed inspection reports, document compliance gaps, identify systemic risks, and provide practical recommendations for remediation. Issue corrective action requirements to non-compliant vendors, establish binding remediation timelines, and track outstanding actions through to verified resolution. Conduct follow-up inspections to confirm that corrective measures have been implemented effectively and sustainably. Maintain an accurate global vendor compliance register covering inspection history, corrective actions, risk exposure, and current compliance status. Escalate persistent or serious non-compliance and recommend appropriate measures, including sanctions, suspension, or vendor replacement when necessary. Act as the primary security compliance contact for external vendors, communicating expectations clearly and assertively to security and operational leadership. Conduct structured vendor security reviews, support new-vendor assessments, and define security requirements that must be met before operational activation. Prepare global compliance reports for leadership, identify recurring patterns across vendors or regions, and recommend improvements to standards, policies, procedures, and enforcement mechanisms. Work closely with regional security teams across the USA, EU, Taiwan, APAC, Israel, and future operating regions to maintain consistent security expectations and enforcement. Requirements Significant professional experience in supply chain security compliance, vendor auditing, physical security, or security standards enforcement. Proven experience conducting physical security inspections and compliance assessments across complex, multi-vendor or international environments. Strong experience managing corrective action processes, including documenting deficiencies, setting remediation requirements, escalating issue

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:abd22b8d-f74.description: About Welo Data Welo Data, a Welo Global brand, is the multilingual data and evaluation partner for foundation labs and enterprises deploying GenAI systems globally. They deliver the human judgment, data infrastructure, and evaluation systems that ensure AI models perform reliably across languages, cultures, and real-world contexts, at every stage from training through deployment. Its global network of 500,000+ vetted experts spans 300+ languages and locales, enabling high-quality multilingual data creation and structured model evaluation across the full spectrum of modern AI applications — from large language models and voice and speech systems to agentic workflows and robotics and embodied AI. This breadth of linguistic, cultural, and domain expertise enables Welo Data to address critical AI development challenges, including safety, bias, inclusivity, and cross-lingual reliability. A unified global operating model, led by specialized program and quality experts and grounded in assessment-driven talent selection, localized rubrics, and continuous calibration, ensures consistent performance across languages, domains, and modalities. Underpinning all of this is NIMO™ (Network Identity Management and Operations), Welo Data's proprietary identity and fraud-prevention framework. Built to maintain data integrity and workforce trust across a global contributor base, NIMO combines advanced verification, continuous monitoring, and structured QA to ensure every dataset is accurate, traceable, and culturally grounded. welodata.ai About the Role: We are seeking bilingual language specialists to evaluate machine-translated song lyrics. The focus is on assessing the quality and accuracy of translations from English (US) to French (France). This is a review-only role—no rewriting or editing is required. Your feedback will directly contribute to improving automated translation systems. Key Responsibilities: - Review and assess machine-translated lyrics for meaning, fluency, and naturalness. - Provide quality ratings based on predefined evaluation criteria. - Identify issues such as mistranslations, awkward phrasing, or cultural inaccuracies. - Maintain consistent and objective judgment throughout the review process. Project Details: - Job Title: Lyric Translation Reviewer - Location: Remote, France, US, Spain - Schedule: Flexible; Average 4 hours per day - Start Date: ASAP - Employment Type: Freelance - Project Duration: Ongoing Note: Welo Data uses state-of-the-art fraud detection systems to ensure all freelancers engaged in the project do not misrepresent their identity, location, or financial details. Required Qualifications: - Native-level or near-native proficiency in both English (US) and French (France). - Strong understanding of linguistic nuances, idiomatic expressions, and cultural context in both languages. - Ability to focus on detail and maintain concentration over large volumes of content. - Previous experience in translation, localization, or linguistic quality evaluation is a plus but not required. - [Nice to have] Familiarity with different music genres and lyrical styles. - [Nice to have] Experience using online evaluation tools or platforms.
